title: Wings of Fire Pack
description: This is a compilation of all of my wings of fire resource packs, plus a few extra features that don't warrant their own packs.
body:
A Compilation of my Wings of Fire Resource Packs, along with some extra features.

Features:
- Replaces all mentions of the Ender Dragon with Darkstalker.
- Changes the Enchant table to use the Dragon Language.
- Adds two more moons to the sky.
- Removes all existing splashes and replaces them with wings of fire themed ones.
